intro.label: Company overview
intro.lead: Cosmo Trade LLC was founded in 1993 and has built many years of experience in importing, selling and distributing fast-moving consumer goods.
intro.body1: We work with international and regional brands from the USA, Europe and Asia, supplying the Mongolian market with products that meet consumer needs and changes in the market. To make products more accessible to consumers, we keep expanding our partnerships through supermarkets, hypermarkets, retail and wholesale trade, and HORECA, the hotel, restaurant and catering sector.
intro.body2: We also work to introduce and grow international brands in the Mongolian market, increase product sales and develop our own brands. Building on our experience, reliable partnerships and distribution capability, we aim to create long-term value for consumers, customers and business partners, and to contribute to the sustainable growth of our industry.
